name: subnetUtilization
description: The 1,000 most utilized IPv4 subnets in Device42, optionally above a minimum size, with how many of their addresses are in use

getArgs.value: {{ (() => { const min = Number([].concat(typeof minimumSize === 'undefined' ? [] : minimumSize)[0]); return 'select subnet_id, name, cidr, category, service_level, customer, capacity, used_ips,' + ' greatest(capacity - used_ips, 0) as free_ips,' + ' case when capacity > 0 then least(round(100.0 * used_ips / capacity, 1), 100) end as utilization' + " from (select s.subnet_pk as subnet_id, coalesce(nullif(s.name, ''), host(s.network) || '/' || s.mask_bits) as name," + " host(s.network) || '/' || s.mask_bits as cidr, s.category_name as category, s.service_level, c.name as customer," + " (power(2, 32 - s.mask_bits) - case when s.mask_bits < 31 then (case when s.allow_network_address::text in ('true', 't', 'yes') then 0 else 1 end) + (case when s.allow_broadcast_address::text in ('true', 't', 'yes') then 0 else 1 end) else 0 end)::bigint as capacity," + ' coalesce(u.used, 0) as used_ips' + ' from view_subnet_v1 s' + ' left join (select subnet_fk, count(*) as used from view_ipaddress_v1 where available = false group by subnet_fk) u on u.subnet_fk = s.subnet_pk' + ' left join view_customer_v1 c on c.customer_pk = s.customer_fk' + ' where family(s.network) = 4 and s.mask_bits between 8 and 32) x' + (Number.isFinite(min) && min > 0 ? ' where capacity >= ' + Math.floor(min) : '') + ' order by utilization desc nulls last, used_ips desc limit 1000'; })() }}

ui.name: minimumSize
ui.label: Minimum size (addresses)
ui.help: Leaves out subnets with fewer usable addresses, such as /30 point-to-point links. For example, 30 keeps /27 and larger.
